## Spatial and spatio-temporal patterns of MODIS fire detections in Ketapang

January–August 2026 · ISSS626 Geospatial Analytics and Applications

| Deliverable | Link | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| Executive Summary | [Open the slides](executive_summary.html) | Quarto revealjs, 10 content slides plus a cover |
| Technical Report | [Read the report](Take-Home_Ex01.html) | Data preparation, spatial and space-time analyses, interpretation, code and references |
| GitHub Repository | [Open the coursework repository](https://github.com/JUNCHENLI2026/ISSS626_GAA) | Repository for the Quarto project and reproducible files |

The report examines the distribution and recurrence of recorded thermal-anomaly detections. It distinguishes descriptive geographic screening from conditional statistical evidence and documents the limits of both.
